1.0.0.de: Erstveröffentlichung: Überwachen und steuern Sie Ihren Mercedes-Benz von Homey aus.

1.0.1.en: Initial release: monitor and control your Mercedes-Benz from Homey.
1.0.1.nl: Eerste release: bewaak en bedien je Mercedes-Benz vanuit Homey.
1.0.1.de: Erstveröffentlichung: Überwachen und steuern Sie Ihren Mercedes-Benz von Homey aus.

1.0.2.en: Change icon to match Homeys guideline and ensure missing flow actions

1.0.3.en: Ready for publishing, fix icon and flow card + fix HTTP 418 API rejection by updating Mercedes SDK headers, improve   WebSocket error handling

1.0.4.en: Translate charging status and charge program codes to readable text, fix WebSocket bug for window status and departure time/mode

1.0.5.en: Added new drive image and change the drive icon + added readme file for nl and de

1.1.4.en: Upgrade Homey sdk and removed double flow card registration

1.1.5.en: Updated widget preview to match guidelines

1.1.6.en: Add charging control action and update icon on actions

1.1.7.en: Add charging control action and update icon on actions

1.1.9.en: Bug fix: Open/close window and underlying websocket bug

1.1.10.en: Charging pause/resume, multi-car widget, geofencing, connector status, vehicle command and capability fixes

1.1.13.en: Fix widget, tier values and deprecated custom trigger for vehicle_locked/vehicle_unlocked

1.1.14.en: Remove the need for the homey:manager:api permission, previous used in the widget

1.1.16.en: Fix auth issue due to outdated ris-sdk-version header

1.1.17.en: Fix engine started/stopped triggers on electric vehicles, restore device repair flow, and migrate engine/ignition/climate capabilities for flow tag support

1.1.18.en: Fix engine started/stopped triggers on electric vehicles, restore device repair flow, and migrate engine/ignition/climate capabilities for flow tag support

1.1.19.en: Deprecate non-functional start/stop charging cards (#32); fix window/sunroof status detection for vehicles that don't report rear windows, e.g. V-Klasse (#31)

1.1.20.en: Fix 'Set maximum charge level' flow card failing with 'API Error: Not Found' (#34) by sending it over the vehicle command channel; remove the unsupported charge program requirement

1.1.21.en: Fix region selection during pairing for non-European accounts

1.1.22.en: Fix max SOC flow card actually changing the charge limit on the vehicle (was silently ignored by Mercedes' backend)

1.1.23.en: Add charging animation sweep to battery bar in car-status widget

1.1.24.en: Fix login failing with 'Unexpected login result: undefined' by handling Mercedes' passkey/biometric setup prompt during login

1.1.25.en: Fixed vehicle data not updating for North America, Asia-Pacific, and China accounts after pairing (live data polling was hitting the wrong regional server).

1.1.26.en: Improved login diagnostics: when sign-in fails, the app now logs exactly which step failed and the underlying cause (HTTP status, network/timeout codes, and the server's response), making regional login problems much easier to troubleshoot.

1.1.27.en: Login troubleshooting: a failed sign-in attempt's step-by-step details are now saved and re-shown in the app log on the next start, so they reliably appear in a diagnostic report even when the app restarts around the failure.

1.1.28.en: The login error popup now shows exactly which step failed and the underlying cause (HTTP status / network error), so a failed sign-in can be diagnosed straight from a screenshot of the error message.

1.1.29.en: Login stability: the app no longer restarts when an unexpected error occurs during sign-in (which could bounce you back to the login page repeatedly), and it now records the reason so login problems can finally be diagnosed.
